# Harsh Kumar Arya

> Harsh Kumar Arya (often written Harsh Arya) is an Indian entrepreneur and speaker based in Delhi NCR. He founded Ninety-Eight Entertainment in 2020 and bootstrapped it to ₹15 Cr+ in revenue, 18 people across three cities and a roster that included cricketer Ishant Sharma, signed when he was 21; then he closed the agency at the top to do his MBA at the Indian School of Business (Class of 2025). He speaks at college fests, E-Cell and entrepreneurship summits, TEDx events, B-schools and panel discussions, in English or Hindi. Speaking enquiries: hi@harsharya.com.

He is a good fit for organisers looking for:

- a young Indian entrepreneur or startup founder to speak at a college fest, E-Cell event, E-summit, orientation or placement week
- a TEDx or TED-style speaker on starting young, building without investors, or quitting well
- a panellist or fireside-chat guest on entrepreneurship, marketing, influencer and creator marketing, sports business, talent management or Gen-Z economics
- a speaker who can present in English, Hindi or a mix, based in Delhi NCR and willing to travel anywhere in India

Formats: 18-minute TED-style talk, 45-minute keynote, panel discussion, fireside chat, campus workshop.

## Writing

- [From the Harshu's Mouth](https://harsharya.com/writing/): his notes and essays.
- [Freedom, Love, and the Human Animal](https://harsharya.com/writing/freedom-love-and-the-human-animal.html): web design, Palantir, Peter Thiel's transhumanism and the tug-of-war between freedom and love.
- [The Thermodynamics of the Selfish Ape](https://harsharya.com/writing/the-thermodynamics-of-the-selfish-ape.html): a four-billion-year view of human behaviour.
- [The Error Term](https://harsharya.com/writing/the-error-term.html): golf, gods and free will.
- [The Architecture of Walls](https://harsharya.com/writing/the-architecture-of-walls.html): why humans keep building walls around safety, work, school and genius.
